description: Khotiv is split between two maps. Ukraine_kyiv holds the village node 337524444 (wikidata Q4500392) with its boundary; Ukraine_kyiv-city holds only the boundary relation 4730394 (no wikidata, its admin_centre node is outside the region), indexed as a village of its own. Searched with both maps, the village must be one row. ukraine_khotiv_region = relation with the node, ukraine_khotiv_city = the same relation without the node.
